Northern Example Bank — Data Operations Student

Northern Example Bank is a fictional employer. The student will document data
definitions, check sample files for completeness, and assist with internal
reporting. The posting asks for Excel, SQL, and careful written communication.

Location: Ottawa, Ontario. Work mode: Hybrid.
Candidates may choose a 4-month or 8-month work term beginning January 2027.
Application deadline: October 22, 2026.

The successful applicant must confirm the final placement length with the
fictional recruiting team. This synthetic text is designed to ensure that the
tool never converts an optional eight-month arrangement into a confirmed one.
